claim: A whole Sinclair alt ROM image removes dependence on NextZXOS's ROM3, whose bytes can differ from what the game reads.

evidence.text: Whole alt ROM image in both builds, the plain build included; the start is the snapshot's own BASIC, no stub.
evidence.quote: Whole alt ROM image (patch.whole-altrom-image) in both builds; the plain build carries Sinclair's ROM too.

evidence.text: Whole alt ROM image in both builds: the build starts from the TOSEC snapshot's own BASIC (PAUSE 0, RANDOMIZE USR 51200).
evidence.quote: Whole alt ROM image (patch.whole-altrom-image) in both builds: the build now starts from the TOSEC snapshot's own BASIC

evidence.text: Pinned build over ROM3 reads 89 ROM data bytes that differ; demonstrated in simulation, not on hardware.
evidence.quote: reads 89 ROM data bytes that differ (ROM paths, 2026-11-04; demonstrated in simulation, not on hardware)

evidence.text: Default runs the Next's own ROM3 (no alt ROM): 5 to 10 ROM bytes it uses differ from the recording's 128K ROM; lockstep in JNext showed no game difference.
evidence.quote: The default runs the Next's own ROM3 (no alt ROM): 5 to 10 ROM bytes it uses differ from the recording's 128K ROM
